description: The networks Gloam runs on, mainnets first, with each vault (pool) address, the private swap routers (Robinhood Chain and Tempo mainnet), the assets you can deposit (on mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0 and OUSD on Tempo; USDG and GLOAM on Robinhood Chain; USDC, EURC, USDT and ETH on Base; USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC and ETH on Ethereum; on testnet: OUSD and PathUSD on Tempo, USDG and ETH on Robinhood Chain, and more on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia), explorers, RPCs and the testnet faucets.

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG and GLOAM), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), "base-mainnet" (Base mainnet: USDC, EURC, USDT, ETH), "ethereum-mainnet" (Ethereum mainnet: USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC, ETH), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet), "base" (Base Sepolia) or "ethereum" (Ethereum Sepolia). Leave out for every network.
